items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: There's a young fella I met about four or five years ago. He's originally from Cleveland. He's living in New York now. Violinist by the name of Everett Lee.

ctx.x: Can you tell me some of your favorite musicians that you've heard? I'm not trying to put you on the spot, because I know that you're in your... Well, there's so many. There's so many. I have... I mean some of the old timers maybe that aren't even living now on different instruments that you've liked.

Well, there are a lot of... Among the newcomers that I admire greatly and have all the respect in the world for them on various instruments. There's a young fella I met about four or five years ago. He's originally from Cleveland. He's living in New York now. Violinist by the name of Everett Lee. He's also a very fine composer. He has toured Europe.
